text: This staff report is about a matter that the Community Council has delegated authority from City Council to make a final decision. This report recommends that an All-Way Stop Control not be installed at the intersection of Hollis Avenue and Eastwood Avenue as the existing conditions do not meet the warrant for the installation of such a traffic control device. This location currently has a stop control facing both the northbound and southbound approach at Eastwood Avenue at this four-way intersection.
Scarborough Community Council: 1. Authorized all-way compulsory stop control at the intersection of Hollis Avenue and Eastwood Avenue.
